summary: Frontend-only testing of 3 additive enhancements: Schedule Icons (Contact), Add to Calendar (Home), Per-event icons (Events grid/Home preview/EventModal). All features verified working correctly with no console errors and no regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: EventIcon.tsx correctly maps all 26 event ids to distinct lucide icons; defensive null-return for unmapped ids is unused but safe.
calendar.ts computes ICS date/time correctly (2026-10-10T08:00+05:30 -> 20261010T023000Z), matches Google Calendar dates param exactly.
No hardcoded backend URLs; app is fully static/client-side as expected.

Category icon (CategoryIcon inside .event-card-tag) and per-event title icon (EventIcon inside .event-card-title) are correctly rendered as two visually distinct icons per card, confirmed via DOM inspection (inner SVG markup differs).
